headline: 2026-27 budget planning update, bus patrol camera implementation, bus passes for high schoolers, grants, teacher hires, curriculum and policy revisions.
summary: The agenda covers a 2026-27 budget planning update and bus patrol camera implementation. It also includes bus passes for high schoolers, grants, personnel items, curriculum and policy revisions, and new business.
items: Student representative reports from Bristol Central High School and Bristol Eastern High School
Consent agenda: teacher hires, teacher leave of absence requests, teacher retirements, A1 and A2 hires and resignations, and an administrative resignation effective October 30, 2026

Consent agenda grants: Federal Adult Education - PEP Comprehensive 2; Prudence Crandall Center - CT Coalition Against Domestic Violence (CCADV); United Way of Central and Northeastern CT Family Resource Center Operating Funds; Early Start (formerly School Readiness); Mainstreet Community Foundation Jim & Eleanor Frawley Community Fund; The Barnes Foundation Storytelling Residency Program; Connecticut High Dosage Tutoring Program; CT Learner Engagement and Attendance Program (LEAP); McKinney-Vento Homeless Children & Youth Program
Curriculum decision: Latin Historical Prose, new course (presenter Leszek Ward)
Curriculum decision: Algebra 2 revision (presenter Laura Lanza)
Curriculum decision: Grade 6-8 Science revision (presenter Laura Lanza)
Revision: Policy 3231 - Medical Reimbursement for Special Education Students
Revision: Policy 5114 - Suspension and Expulsion/Due Process
Policy 1120 - Public Participation at Board of Education Meetings
Donation from the BCHS Athletics Activities account to the BCHS Press Box project
First review of proposed school calendars for 2027/2028 and 2028/2029 school years
First review of proposed 2027 Board of Education meeting dates
location: BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 06010
